http_route_groups.description: Bounded route groups resolved after Django URL matching.

http_operations.description: Bounded semantic operation names for resolved routes.

http_status_codes.description: Exact HTTP status codes, represented as an inclusive range plus other.

db_context_groups.description: Bounded route or task context groups.

celery_events.description: Celery lifecycle events; terminal state is carried by outcome.

celery_outcomes.description: Celery task metric outcomes; domain outcomes use a separate registry.

telemetry_violation_fields.description: Bounded fields reported by contract violations.

worker_refs.description: Versioned HMAC-derived worker references; values are deployment-specific.

privacy_constraints: Never use raw paths, query strings, IDs, IP addresses, credentials, or exception messages as labels or event fields.
coverage.operator_query: Rate 5xx responses by route_group and operation; inspect the correlated trace and failed-request event.

privacy_constraints: Never export SQL text, bound parameters, raw task names, raw routes, IDs, or exception messages.
coverage.operator_query: Compare query duration and error rates by workload and context_group; inspect the privacy-safe query event.

privacy_constraints: The application does not configure a database connection pool; no pool credentials or topology are part of this contract.
coverage.operator_query: Not applicable: CinemataCMS uses direct Django database connections.

not_applicable.reason: CinemataCMS does not configure a database connection pool.
not_applicable.validation_rule: CI rejects a pool backend or pool settings unless this row is replaced by a covered pool signal.

privacy_constraints: Never use cache keys, tokens, IDs, password-derived values, or raw exceptions as labels or event fields.
coverage.operator_query: Compare hit, partial_hit, miss, mutation, and error rates by family; inspect the logical operation trace.

privacy_constraints: Never record credentials, tokens, password-derived values, user IDs, IP addresses, or raw authorization headers.
coverage.operator_query: Rate authentication failures by surface, mechanism, and reason; dependency_unavailable must map to HTTP 503.

privacy_constraints: Keep full task names and task IDs in restricted traces only; metrics use task_family and bounded queue/event/outcome.
coverage.operator_query: Compare terminal failure and retry rates by task_family and queue; follow the child trace to PostgreSQL, Redis, and HTTP spans.

privacy_constraints: worker_ref is a versioned HMAC reference; never use hostnames, pod names, IPs, queue names, or raw worker IDs.
coverage.operator_query: Compare heartbeat age by service_role and worker_ref; a role-only heartbeat indicates missing identity and a contract violation.

privacy_constraints: Use only fixed operation, outcome, and reason_code vocabularies; never include IDs, filenames, URLs, or exception text.
coverage.operator_query: Break terminal domain failures down by operation and reason_code; compare with task execution outcomes.

privacy_constraints: Use fixed media labels only; never export media IDs, filenames, source paths, URLs, or exception text.
coverage.operator_query: Compare encoding failures and input size/duration by bounded profile labels; inspect the media pipeline event.

privacy_constraints: Use recipient_ref only in restricted structured logs/traces; never use addresses, subjects, bodies, credentials, IDs, or task names in metric labels.
coverage.operator_query: Treat smtp_accepted as the success boundary; investigate failed or unknown outcomes with recipient_ref-correlated restricted telemetry.

privacy_constraints: Use only registered job names and bounded outcome/reason_code values; never export task IDs or exception text.
coverage.operator_query: Alert on a registered job whose last success exceeds its absence window; inspect the run outcome and reason code.

privacy_constraints: Signals, components, and stages are fixed; warning fields exclude exception text and sensitive payloads.
coverage.operator_query: Rate emission failures by signal, component, and stage; verify application request/task result is unchanged.

privacy_constraints: Record only bounded component and field names; never include the invalid raw value.
coverage.operator_query: Investigate contract violation increases by component and field; the normalized fallback must preserve application behavior.
